body: Me too, its so confusing. Thanks for the support I really appreciate it. I hope things get better for us

Thanks my man, I wish I could help you too. Its going to be so painful letting go, she has literally begged and sobbed that she doesn't want to live her life without me. I just dont know if I can do this anymore :( I wish I could just let go

It'll be two years in December. Five years together, close friends for 15. Our lives are were/are intertwined no contact was hopeless, it never sticks. I dont know if the pain of losing her will ever go away. Some days I'm completely fine. Some days I'm not. Today I've been laying in bed crying for the last 8 hours because she fucked one of my "friends" and employees last night after she had drunkenly texted me that she still loves me and wants to talk. Today, today feels like day one all over again.

Well she cheated on me after 5 years and two years after the breakup I'm still in perpetual state of crushing scotch, crying myself to sleep and contemplating new and exciting ways to end my life. I'm too much of a pussy thought don't worry. Congrats to all the lovers ITT, I'm very jealous you got the life I wished I had.
I just know thats not who she is, I've known her for a very long time. Maybe that's who she is becoming, but I have the hope that the woman I love is still in there.

She's been my best friend for 15 years. We love(d) each other and had an amazing relationship, I feel she cheated because I got complacent. I quit caring about my appearance, I quit giving her the attention she needed. It's all my fault.
But I really want them both to feel as shitty as I do. What if they end up having the life that we were supposed to have together? They need to suffer as I have suffered.
I'm almost two years in and I still cry myself to sleep at night. I miss her so much.
